summary: Both targets promoted to full records. Ep 23 'The Awaited' = chapters 62-63 + 65 with 64 deferred to ep 24: stated identically by the To Your Eternity fandom wiki episode infobox and by animefillerguide's season-2 table (which also gives ep 24 = 64, 66, matching the stored ep-24 anchor), and backed by the title lattice (ep 23 title = ch 62 'The Awaited One'; ep 24 title = ch 64 'The Young Man Who Can See'); episode plays 62 -> 63 -> 65 (arrival/welcome at Uralis last), so end=65, continue=64. Ep 48 'Trouble' = chapter 135 plus the grafted ch-132 opening (Mizuha heading to the beach to see Fushi, cut from ep 46 and used as ep 48's cold open — wiki trivia states this explicitly): the wiki ep-48 infobox says '135 & 136', but its own ep-49 infobox says 137-138 while the ep-49 plot clearly adapts ch 136 content (Mimori's essay, her backstory), the ch-135.4 part summary ends exactly where ep 48's synopsis ends (Hirotoshi's naked plea to save his sister), and Wikipedia's chapter list shows ch 135 = 'Trouble' (= ep 48's title) and ch 136 = 'Rejected Life' (= ep 49's title). Recorded end=135, flagged the infobox discrepancy. The surrounding lattice (ep 46 = 130-132 'Proof of Peace' = ch 130; ep 47 = 133-134, ch 133 'Record: Hirotoshi' backstory + ch 134 'Attack' = ep title 'The Attack'; stored ep 49 end=138 v15) all locks consistently. No repairs.

anchors.note: Order shuffled around the Uralis arrival: 62 (Bon appears; ch title = ep title 'The Awaited') -> 63 (Bon introduces himself) -> 65 (journey to and welcome at Uralis), with ch 64 (Bon's POV chapter, = ep 24's title) deferred to ep 24 {64, 66}. Fandom wiki infobox and animefillerguide agree exactly; ch 65 opens v8.

Cold open = ch 132's cut opening (Mizuha going to see Fushi; wiki trivia: 'the scene in the last chapter of volume 14... is shown as a flashback in this episode, right before... she asks him on a date'), then ch 135 'Trouble' (title match, Wikipedia) through its final scene (Hirotoshi's plea, = end of part 135.4). Wiki ep-48 infobox claims '135 & 136' but ch 136 'Rejected Life' content (essay/backstory) is adapted in ep 49 (whose title = ch 136's title), so end=135; ep 49 re-plays the last beats of 135.4 before continuing. Ch 135 is in v15 (133-138).

continue_points.note: Ch 64 is skipped by ep 23 (adapted at ep 24's start as Bon's POV flashback); honest resume after ep 23 is 64, not end+1 (66).

annotation_updates.note: Confirmed and sharpened: ch 132's opening scene (Mizuha heading to the beach), cut from ep 46 (wiki ep-46 differences section notes the omission), is ep 48's cold-open flashback placed right before the date-ask. Rest of ep 48 is ch 135 only.

Recorded ep 48 end=135, medium.
